name: @oge-ui/charts-engine
description: Framework-free engine behind the OGE UI charts (Angular @oge-ui/charts and React @oge-ui/react-charts): nice-tick, log, category and calendar-true time scales, series normalization, stacking and bar slotting, single-path and LTTB-downsampled path builders, pie/doughnut and radar layout, zoom and pan math, binary-search hit-testing, the cartesian/pie/polar/range-selector view-model builders, keyboard maps, the pointer-gesture machine, the message catalog and the dependency-free SVG/PNG image export. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
